children: Nuvve announced two financing actions. The company issued a $280,000 12% convertible note to FirstFire Global Opportunities Fund for $250,000 in proceeds after discount, convertible after six months at the lesser of $1.40 per share or 85% of the recent lowest price, with a 2027 maturity and a 4.99% conversion cap. Separately, Nuvve exchanged all 2,238.655 outstanding Series A Preferred shares for newly created Series C Convertible Preferred shares carrying an 8% cumulative dividend, a $1.40 conversion price with full ratchet anti-dilution, senior ranking, and amended registration rights. Together, these steps aim to bolster liquidity and streamline the capital structure.
